properties.name: decision
properties.description: Usage decision. VOCABULARY MEASURED 2026-07-12 over the FULL population (qms.inspection_lots, GROUP BY decision): ACCEPT (281.698), REWORK (33.518), REJECT (16.574) — no NULLs. The lot_rejected rule `decision ne 'REJECT'` is ALIVE and hits real data. Verified nightly by ci/check-vocab-drift.mjs.

The inspected object: a material sublot (Quant = MaterialSubLot) (B2MML TestResult.TestableObjectID).

constraints.name: lot_rejected
constraints.description: Decided inspection lot was rejected (usage decision = REJECT) — quality escalation.

isa95.note: Inspection lot = TestResult (B2MML OperationsTest): the lot is the tested object, the usage decision is the evaluated criterion result. Core 6.0.0 (owner 30.10.2026): the tested object may be the article, a material lot (MaterialLot) or sublot (Quant), as for TestResult.
isa95.mappingNote: TestResult carries no order and no workflow state; both are OSF joins on the lot. TestResult carries no equipment, lot type, lot status, lot quantity or sample size either. Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent). created_at is the day the lot was opened, not the evaluation date of B2MML TestResult.EvaluationDate (the usage decision) — no source of the demo plant has that date (audit M4).
isa95.grain: one test result of material (ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.9 TestResult): one row = one inspection lot — the tested article, material lot (MaterialLot) or sublot (Quant) with its usage decision, keyed by lot_no; the test result of a person, machine or tool is TestResult
